{{Quote|There are two ways to destroy a person, Jorj. Kill him, or ruin his reputation.''"<br />"''I suppose that makes sense. Any idea which approach Nuso Esva's planning?''"<br />"''If I know Nuso Esva, very likely both.|[[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Jorj Car'das]]|<ref name="CoO" />}}
A large-scale battle took place in the remote [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], primarily above the double [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Poln Major]] and [[Poln Minor]] between elements of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the forces of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The Imperial forces, led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], succeeded in shattering the formidable power of Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]], driving the alien warlord from Imperial space.
